verdict.rationale: Invitee time-zone handling is a fair question for a scheduling-link product, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions time-zone detection, time-zone display, or DST handling. The pack covers booking pages, embeds, availability, webhooks and routing, none of which addresses this story. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, invitees always see slots in their own time zone — detection, display, and DST handling are automatic
